name: mesurer-codex
description: Queues Mesurer browser feedback to Codex and reports the matching turn lifecycle through a local loopback companion.

interface.shortDescription: Queue Mesurer feedback to the current Codex thread
interface.longDescription: Starts or reuses Mesurer's loopback Codex companion, registers the current session, queues Mesurer feedback, and reports matching queued-turn lifecycle state so completed annotations can be retired safely.
